issue.title: Status of testing Providers that were prepared on February 26, 2026
issue.body:
### Body

I have a kind request for all the contributors to the latest provider distributions release.
Could you please help us to test the RC versions of the providers?

The guidelines on how to test providers can be found in

[Verify providers by contributors](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors)

Let us know in the comments, whether the issue is addressed.

These are providers that require testing as there were some substantial changes introduced:

I tested `apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes==10.13.0rc1` (my PR #62284 — init_containers merge fix).

**Environment:** Airflow 3.1.7, Python 3.11.2, K3s v1.34.4+k3s1 (Kubernetes), Debian 12

**Tests performed:**
1. **Unit test** — `reconcile_specs()` with same-named init containers — merged correctly (1 container, not 2). PASS
2. **5 programmatic scenarios** — same name merge, image override, args preservation, env/volume_mounts extension, different names preserved — all passed. PASS
3. **Integration test** — KubernetesPodOperator with `init_containers` on real K3s cluster — pod created and completed successfully. PASS
4. **Deep integration** — `full_pod_spec` + `init_containers` with same-named init container — correctly merged, no K8s duplicate name error. PASS

**Verdict: All 8 tests passed.** The RC is working correctly for this fix.
